notes.title: Ark's Wonder Dungeon V1.5.0
notes.notes:
Hello! This patch is a major update that reworks a few story bosses, tweaked Clown, and adds a unique series of cutscenes to the late game. Other decently big changes included, too. I guess.



[h2]BOSS BUFFS[/h2]
CHAPTER 6:
[spoiler]Like 1.4's patch notes predicted, some Dark Side bosses needed some tweaks (thankfully, not as many as I thought.)
-Glutton's agility is upper to 8 from 5.

-MOTHER no longer counters.
-MOTHER's agility is lowered to 15 from 36.

-BROTHER's Elemental Wilt confusion chance is now 5% instead of 30%.
-Brother's Elemental Wilt now has an 80% chance of removing Eletection.[/spoiler]

CHAPTER 8:
[spoiler]Evil Empress' first phase has gotten some decently significant buffs.
-Evil Empress defense is raised from 45 from 30.
-Evil Empress agility is raised to 7 from 6.
-Evil Empress health is 2250, up from 2000.
-Knight Ending damage cap is now 90 instead of 55.[/spoiler]


CHAPTER 9:
[spoiler]Pure Ark has gotten quite a few buffs. Feel free to complain if she's too busted. (Bring wipes.)

-When she's under 30% HP, every form shift will cause her to be inflicted with enraged and glass. If she has enraged 1, she'll get enraged 2, etc. Enraged 3 and beyond, she'll get shattered glass instead.
-Pure Weight will now burn through resists. (Dark Shield is safe.)
-Pure Ark will no longer use either Sedate status move.
-If Irate, Pure Ark will spam Botched Purification until she is no longer Irate.
-Wincing Wipe's damage is now 25 instead of 10.
-Reverse Revenge no longer 100% confuses, ignores taunt, and will hit three random targets.
-Pure Hand will now hit everybody. It only succeeds 40% of the time. It will set all hit target's ATB to 10%.
-Pure Ark's melee form now has a 30% chance to inflict glass on hit.[/spoiler]

CHAPTER 10:

[spoiler]IMPURITY's defense raised from 7 to 77.
He's supposed to be the hardest boss. He WILL be the hardest boss. Bring Brick Hand or perish.[/spoiler]


[h2]CLOWN TWEAKS[/h2]
[spoiler]Honking over and over again to gain more Clown Score was turned far more braindead by 1.1's Wait command. Tweaked some things to make it more actively strategic and make Melon Mime have a more limited but dynamic playstyle.

Study can now only be used 5 times per battle. It gives double the Clown Score when used against bosses.
It will remove any stuns and set the target's ATB to 90% so you'll have to study only when you think you can take hits.

Clown's Experimentation was rarely used despite it being the optimal way of gaining Clown Score later in runs. It no longer has a warm-up, costs 30 MP to use, and has had its cooldown tweaked from 10 to 30.[/spoiler]

[h2]OVERPOWERED ITEM REWORKS:[/h2]
Omni-Orb:
-Omni-Orb's cooldown is now 20 turns instead of 5.
-Omni-Orb's cost is now 200 instead of 50.
-Omni-Orb now does 36 guaranteed damage instead of 60.

Ark's Flail:
-Ark's Flail will no longer randomly stun the user.
-Ark's Flail will now lower your attack by 50% when you're above 95% HP.
-Ark's Flail will now only raise your attack and critical chance when you're below 40% HP. (Down from 50%.)
-Ark's Flail will only enraged you at the start of battles if you're on room 50 or above.


[h2]NEW MAGNIFICO CUTSCENES:[/h2]
There are now six unique cutscenes that play whenever you die and you've gotten a character's ending. [spoiler]They were written to give Magnifico a better paced character leading up to the finale.[/spoiler]

[h2]ENCUMBERED ALERT:[/h2]
A very simple change, but the backpack UI element will now change its graphic whenever your inventory is actually full.


[h2]VARIOUS CHANGES AND FIXES:[/h2]
-Scarecrow's Depression no longer has a miss chance. Instead, it lowers your agility by 40%.
-Scarecrow's Wrath lowers your defense by 50% instead of the previous 15%.
-Scarecrow's Greed lowers your recovery by 50% instead of the previous 25%.
-Campfire stories should be much, much more common.
-John's Spellbook now works properly as a book buff.
-Avenger's Malice achievement slightly reworked in an attempt to fix a bug where it couldn't be achieved.
-[spoiler]Merchant Jr's Pay to Win now gets powered up even when she is not in the party.[/spoiler]
-Annoying text box that keeps appearing when you hold both crowns should be gone.
-[spoiler]In Enraged Mode, you should be able to encounter enemies in rooms 1-15 in areas past Mossy Ruins again.[/spoiler]

notes.title: Ark's Wonder Dungeon V1.4.0
notes.notes:
Hello! This patch is both a major update to a late game area and adding a save failure recovery system. Steam Cloud has also been enabled(?)



[h2]SAVE FAILURE RECOVERY SYSTEM[/h2]
Some people have reported minor save file failures in the Discord server. While your in-game achievements wouldn't be wiped, some other progress would seemingly be loaded into a new game state and 

There is now a special sequence that happens if you boot up the game while Ark has 0 rooms and 0 battles, but you have the achievement of collecting Jeneral Jeorge. This sequence will take a look at many important achievements and set several major variables that handle both progression and chains of achievements.

Even if you don't have a save failure, the game has a smaller set of conditional branches that will make sure your game's progression is kept up with where your in-game achievements suggest you should be.


CHAPTER 6 BOSS GENERAL REWORKS (SPOILERS!)
[spoiler]So, Dark Side has been through a whole lot of development turmoil. Its bosses have gotten changed around several times, and right now, it's in an okay spot, if not a bit tedious and boring. The goal of this update is to make the Dark Side bosses have a more dynamic fight alongside adding some difficulty.

At the beginning of each Dark Side's boss fight, all party members besides the leader will lose their ability to use Attack. They will gain a new skill called "REPENT" that will seal their Skills, Magic, and Prepare as well, but give the entire party a multi-hit burst move that costs HP. For each ally that repents, a riskier but more rewarding version of this burst move will be learned.

Each boss (except GLUTTON) is now immune to Slog and Acid.

This should add a lot more strategy on how you deal with both going against the bosses generally and how you manage coming into Dark Side. Stocking up on items and healing equipment is generally preferred to the raw damage/speed output that the rest of the game's meta focuses around.

Future patches will likely have to touch these up more, but this should generally be a much better place for them to be in.[/spoiler]

CHAPTER 6 BOSS REMAKES (SPOILERS!)

GENERAL'S:
[spoiler]MOTHER used to just be a nothing boss. She has now been given a unique mechanic: She will pacify Jeorge's allies, thus stunning them. When she does attack, she will apply Dark Scarecrow status effects with simply damage ignoring blades. The only way to say Jeorge's allies from the status effects are using his skills on them.

She has been redesigned this way to better counter Jeorge's overall moveset: No matter how high Jeorge tries to stack his defense, it never make a difference. The optimal strategy is to utilize counters to your benefit and bring elixirs for ability cooldown.[/spoiler]

MERCHANT'S:
[spoiler]GLUTTON was pretty broken before this patch. She's gotten a completely new design because of that. She will target the ally with the lowest HP, instantly killing them most of the time. This is very dangerous because if the party leader dies in a Dark Side fight, the fight is instantly over. Whenever you hit GLUTTON, you will also automatically get Farmer's Greed, which now seals all gold-related skills.

Upon starting the fight, Jr. will learn two gold-cost skills: Poison Soup and Feed. Feed will stun GLUTTON temporarily but heal her 5 HP. Poison Soup will temporarily stun an ally and send them down to near-death. These are both tools that can be used to direct GLUTTON elsewhere. She is also the only boss that acid can be used on; GLUTTON will do self-damage and become enraged.

The new design is made to make Junior have to balance between sacrificing her teammates to stay alive while healing them to have them do damage, as Junior attacking directly will cause her to have to Focus the Farmer's Greed away.[/spoiler]

MISC & BUG CHANGES:
-Whilst playing in [spoiler]Enraged Mode[/spoiler], you will now never encounter an enemy in rooms 14 and below.
-Update Ultra Double or Nothing's Description
-Changed Event: Spores achievement to be far easier to get.
-Ark's "Tag!" upgrade should now be properly revealed when booting up [spoiler]Enraged Mode[/spoiler] for the first time.
-Fixed and Buffed Omni-Orb (30 base damage to 60 base damage)
-Fixed Henchrock Achievement not displaying its value.
-Fixed Animate Blade being impossible to get due to [spoiler]Animate Magic and Animate Lore[/spoiler] not counting.
-Fixed Campfire Story #35 being unable to be found if you had already read Campfire Story #34.

notes.title: Ark's Wonder Dungeon V1.3
notes.notes:
Hello! This patch is a change-up to the game in order to make John B. Castin' a more viable character as an ally rather than only being a desirable party leader. Along with that, there's also some minor touch-ups to Ark's skills.

[h2]MEDITATE[/h2]
Meditates's downsides were not worth it later in the game, so I've decided to tweak it.
-Attack and defense cap of 10 removed; now halves attack and defense.
-Meditate spell now has a cooldown of 5 turns.

[h2]SPELLBOOK[/h2]
Spellbook was okay before, but really only had any practical use when John was the leader and had the time to gather up all that Max MP. In an attempt to make a random John ally more worth it, it's been buffed a whole lot.
First, here are the nerfs:
-Spellbook now has a cooldown of 7 turns. Upped from 2.
-Spellbook now costs a flat 12% MP to use.

Here are the buffs:
-LUCK now factors in very heavily to spell learning chance. (10 LUCK should give you a static 20% chance to always learn the Spellbook's used spell, and that's without factoring in John's Max Mp.)
-Spellbook will replenish all party members for 7 MP multiplied by how many Elixirs are currently being held.
-Spellbook will replenish all party members for 4 MP multiplied by how many Mana UP potions are currently being held.
-Spellbook will replenish all party members for 1 MP multiplied by how many Potions are currently being held.
-Before casting the random spell, John will cast a low-damaging elemental defense-ignoring spell for each unique elemental resist he has.
-Before casting the random spell, John will cast a low-damaging non-elemental defense-ignoring spell if he has prepared.
-Eletection makes him cast all four elemental spells at once. These stack with the ones cast from the resists.
-Having the Lucky status effect will make John always learn the spell.
-Having Agnosia will make John always learn the spell. However, he will lose 1 attack and 2 defense after doing so.
(Please note that the two above effects do not apply for Super Spells!)

To go along with the Agnosia change, the Fog spell has been made to require 75% MP and HP to cast.

The goal with these Spellbook changes is to turn an early John ally into a spell dump who you can build to be a strong, consistent attacker along with lots of utility, and a late game John ally as an asset to be a constant source of MP given you have the items.

[h2]ARK[/h2]
I also wanted to make the Persevere and Purify combo a bit more unique:
-Persevere no longer prevents death and removes mana costs. Instead, it gives Ark a 50% damage resist and 20% HP regeneration.
-Purify will now 100% remove Persevere when used.
-Persevere now lasts for 5 turns instead of 3.
-Purify now only heals based on half of Ark's Max HP.

Overall, consistent damage resists appear to be stronger in the game's balance, and I would like to make Ark less of a one trick pony.


[h2]BUG FIXES AND TWEAKS:[/h2]
-Crouch Down's removal on hit is now 50% instead of 100%.
-Crouch Down can now be between 3 and 5 turns. Upper from between 3 and 4 turns.
-Made Pained Pray give 50% MP.
-Fixed Pained Pray's description.
-Fixed Wake's description.
-Omni-Orb has been heavily buffed. It now does 3 attacks instead of 1, each doing 10 damage that ignores defense along with the main portion that takes defense into account. Also, the main formula is now 30% stronger. The hope is that this item is now more viable for late game bosses, particularly getting past their damage caps.
-Elixir Pump now requires 10 MP and will no longer bump up HP even if no Max MP is present.
[spoiler]-Dark Shield was super broken before. Now it works as a fourth Resist stage that is immune to all dark status effects. Acid and wipes don't remove it.[/spoiler]

notes.title: Ark's Wonder Dungeon v1.2
notes.notes:
Hello! This patch is a change-up to the game's meta in an attempt to create a less dominant (but still applicable) playstyle!

[h2]IRATE[/h2]
As of V1.1, the most prominent strategy for most of AWD's life has been getting high agility and stunlocking bosses with interrupting skills. This is fun, sure, but it does result in most fights having a similar "winning strategy."

This update introduces a new game mechanic related to interrupting enemies: Irate.
Every single skill that either fully interrupts or delays a foe's cast now has a 5% chance to inflict them with Irate.
Irate will increase the foe's agility by 50% and attack by 10%, lasting for two attacks. Each tier of boss has a higher chance of being inflicted by this status when hit, final bosses having a 100% chance of infliction.

This change is meant to suppress mass interrupting during late-game boss fights by making it have a consequence that you need to deal with. If you're going to try and stunlock the boss, you better have a plan on how to deal with the storm afterwards.

Of course, this couldn't be the only thing done, as most of the major interrupt methods are far too strong.

[h2]INTERRUPT NERFS:[/h2]
-Flyswatter is no longer is a full interrupt but rather a cast delay.
-Super Flyswatter's turn cooldown is now 20 instead of 10.
-CofCheChi's Jab turn cooldown is now 3 instead of 1.
-Banana is no longer an instant move.

Interrupting should still be viable as a strategy throughout most of the early-middle game, only getting truly risky as you start to enter into the super/final boss territory.


[h2]GENERAL BALANCES:[/h2]
-HP Boost has been HEAVILY buffed: +50% max HP -> +100% max HP and doubled recovery. It has gone from a 10 turn effect to a 5 turn effect. These changes are so it can better compete with Resist as a defensive status.
-Potions now give HP Boost. Hopefully this will make them a tad higher priority.
-Jr Soup IV now gives HP boost instead of Resist. It now has a 33% chance to apply Resist. 20 turn cooldown -> 40 turn cooldown.
-Jeorge's Glove has a unique item now! It can be used in battle to have a chance of obtaining Survival and Wall.
-John's Spellbook has a unique item now! It can be used to gain 10% MP and has a chance of applying Agnosia.
-CofCheChi's Shifty now is removed on hit and caps defense to 10. This change was made to push him back into the role of "glass cannon" rather than "unhittable jack-of-all-trades". (Highly recommend setting him up with either countering or miss chance items.)
-John's Spellbook can now start teaching him spells once he's reached 50 max MP instead of the previous 100 max MP.
-Natural element weakness icons now have red cracks to further set them apart from the normal elemental weakness icons.
-Audience Pot's base defense lowered down from 10 to 8.

[h2]BUG FIXES:[/h2]
-way, way too many typo fixes. i'm embarrassed.
-Clover and Spell: Magnifico items now display their correct icons.
-Elemental Books' charms now apply over the whole party properly now.
-[spoiler]Fixed the Chompling turning into a second Evil Empress. No, I don't want to talk about it.[/spoiler]

Don't forget to join the [url=https://discord.gg/CuDv73h5tF]Discord [/url]and follow the [url=https://x.com/ShoeStealin]Twitter [/url]if you're enjoying the game and want to submit bugs/give feedback! Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Ark's Wonder Dungeon v1.1
notes.notes:
Hello! This patch tinkers with several things that both should help with gameplay flow and giving more power to the player while still forcing them to move forward.

[h2]STEAM OVERLAY[/h2]
Steam Overlay (Shift+Tab) should now work! Take as many screenshots as your heart desires.

[h2]CLARITY[/h2]
-Almost all equipment and skill descriptions have been modified for clarity, color coding, and icons. Skills that either don't end the turn, are instant, or interrupt are all now color coded, so you don't skip over these important common effects. Status effects that the skill mentions now display their icons instead of writing them out.

[h2]STATUS REWRITE[/h2]
-Along with this change is an almost complete rewrite to every single status effect's mouse description. They have been made to cut out as much flavor text as possible and give pure information. Status effects also no longer appear above player heads to clear out some additional room on the screen.

[h2]NEW SKILL: WAIT[/h2]
-Each character now has a new skill called Wait. It is an instant skill that does absolutely nothing, the main purpose of it being a tool to temporarily stall. It has a cooldown of 1 turn.

[h2]LUCK COMEBACK[/h2]
-Failing multiple runs in a row will cause your LUCK to start out higher. The highest this can go is 7 after 5 failed runs.

[h2]ENEMY CHANGES[/h2]
-All the Sunken Wreck enemies now resist only fire and water, being weak to earth.
-Martians are now weak to wind.
-Evolving Slime, Animate Slime, and Slime Queen are now weak to fire.
-Crashing Rocks are now weak to earth.

[h2]BALANCES[/h2]
Along with this is an absolute grocery list of different changes, so here they are:
-Prepare no longer removes 4% MP when used to incentivize it being used more.
-All elemental hexes have a 10% chance to give Eletection.
-Elixir Infused Boot's Coward's Cape effect now gives +15 max MP instead of +5 max MP.
-Coward's Cape now has a unique "Yes" button.
-Steroids now give +1 max HP when used. This surely won't have any consequences.
-Lowered Weight's skill slog chance. 50% to 15%.
-All elemental glove cleanses have been reworked. They no longer have a chance to remove other weaknesses. Instead, they will heal 10 HP to all party members. If they wipe an elemental weakness off of a party member, that party member will be fully healed.
-Weighted Coin now displays how much gold you have.
-Jeorge's Glove's skill buffed. MP cost 80% to MP cost 40%.
-Survival Status' Focus skill now doesn't your turn.
-CofCheChi's Uppercut no longer has a chance to give foes Enraged 2 or 3.
-Lather 2 will now 100% remove all forms of element resistance on the foe, along with its chance of applying lather becoming 40% from 20%.
-Elemental Books now give an information skill that displays how many spells/hexes need to be used before the boost is achieved.
-Elemental Books' charm skills are no longer instant but apply across the party.

[h2]Chapter 4 Spoilers:[/h2]
[spoiler]-Guilty blobs no longer have the user take 999999 damage when used.
-Teletraps on the Moon cause the party to lose 1 max MP. Blood Moon causes the party to lose 2 max MP.
-There's less of a wait after beating Magnifico.
-There's less of a period that the screen is white in Magnifico and Slime Queen defeat cutscenes.[/spoiler]

[h2]Chapter 5 Spoilers:[/h2]
[spoiler]-Merchant Jr's hint about how to get to the Merchant's scrap has been made clearer.
-Melon Mime's phase 2 damage cap is now 100 instead of 66 to balance his high amount of self-healing potential.[/spoiler]

[h2]Chapter 6 Spoilers:[/h2]
[spoiler]-There is now an idle animation to the stage 1 Wyrm statue darkness.[/spoiler]

[h2]Chapter 8 Spoilers:[/h2]
[spoiler]-The Merchant ending status effect now only heals Hades and Thanatos by 25% instead of the previous 50%.[/spoiler]

[h2]MISC & BUG FIXES:[/h2]
-Voodoo Doll achievement now specifies what Wyrm needs to be defeated.
-Ark and CofCheChi Story 1 updated to keep Ark's Eye lore consistent.
-Merchant Jr in the shop now has an idle animation.
-Fixed a bug making Amber Bulwark floor 80 display the wrong locked door.

Don't forget to join the [url=https://discord.gg/CuDv73h5tF]Discord [/url]and follow the [url=https://x.com/ShoeStealin]Twitter [/url]if you're enjoying the game! Thank you for playing!
